title: PSA: Amazon's shopping AI can now tell you if that message is a scam | TechCrunch
summary: Earlier this year, Amazon launched an email address, verify@amazon.com, that allows anyone to forward suspicious messages to the company and receive a response that confirms whether the email was a real message or a scam.
